title: RosterCourse
description:
A course’s properties and their values.

Device Assignment Services 5.0+

name.description: The course name. Maximum length 1024 UTF-8 characters.

op_date.description: The time stamp, in iSO 8601 format, when the course was added, updated, or deleted.

source.description: The data source where the class was created.

source_system_identifier.description: The identifier configured by organization for the course. Maximum length is 256 UTF-8 characters. Value can be null.

unique_identifier.description: The unique identifier for the course. Maximum length 256 UTF-8 characters.
